title_zh: 量化 World Action Models 的因果后果校准
plain_motivation_en:
For a coupled future-video/action World Action Model (WAM), post-training quantization (PTQ) calibration is not only about reproducing local tensor values. A numerical intervention can change the predicted full action chunk; after the first action is executed, it can also change the simulator's next observation. The practical bottleneck is deciding which weight/activation (W/A) sites should stay at high precision when a local PTQ discrepancy does not consistently identify contact-transition consequences. OTC-PTQ therefore treats the full action chunk as an intermediate object and the one resulting control transition as the measurable boundary.

The current Phase 0 frontier makes this boundary testable. QuantWAMs (arxiv:2607.28405v1) makes joint video/action sensitivity and closed-loop protection explicit, QuantWM (arxiv:2602.02110v1) provides a distinct latent rollout/planning sensitivity branch, and Fast-WAM provides the named idm feasibility path without providing a numerical PTQ consequence signal. Together with the stated RoboTwin 2.0/LIBERO manipulation split and Fast-WAM-only staged validation budget, this supports a small one-transition diagnostic, provided the exact Optional IDM checkpoint identity is fixed in the pre-run manifest.

Several adjacent directions are already covered. QuantWAMs measures joint video/action sensitivity and repairs closed-loop protection schedules; QuantWM studies weight/activation PTQ sensitivity and long-horizon latent planning; and Fast-WAM does not provide a numerical PTQ consequence signal for one-site W/A protection allocation. Earlier task-consequence work—VAML, Model Advantage / Value-Aware Model Learning, and Deep Task-Based Quantization—already shows that downstream consequence can guide targeting, while SQIL covers critical-state protection through saliency-weighted QAT and action distillation. The narrower gap is whether one numerical W/A intervention, with every other target site at FP16, can provide a reproducible one-control-transition proxy from paired full-action-chunk and next-observation discrepancy. OTC-PTQ does not claim those broader downstream-consequence or critical-state-targeting principles as new.

If this gap closes, the field gains a bounded diagnostic for identifying when local PTQ discrepancy stops predicting one-control-transition consequence on contact states. It complements QuantWAMs' closed-loop protection branch and QuantWM's latent-planning sensitivity branch. It also enables a test of whether a C_r-ranked schedule transfers to held-out contact-sensitive failures and next-observation deviation under the same precision budget, with permutation separating the consequence association from quantizer and site-count controls. This would not establish task-loss identity, a full-horizon/replan marginal, joint-low-bit optimality, or a bytes/latency objective.
plain_motivation_zh:
对于一个耦合 future-video/action 的 World Action Model（WAM），post-training quantization（PTQ）校准不只是复现局部 tensor 数值。一次 numerical intervention 可能改变模型预测的完整 action chunk；只执行第一个 action 后，simulator 的 next observation 也可能改变。实际瓶颈是选择哪些 weight/activation（W/A）site 保持 high precision，因为 local PTQ discrepancy 并不能稳定识别 contact-transition states 上的 consequence。因此，OTC-PTQ 把完整 action chunk 当作中间对象，把随后产生的一次 control transition 作为可测量边界。

当前 Phase 0 frontier 使这个边界可以被测试。QuantWAMs（arxiv:2607.28405v1）明确处理 joint video/action sensitivity 和 closed-loop protection，QuantWM（arxiv:2602.02110v1）提供不同的 latent rollout/planning sensitivity 分支，Fast-WAM 则提供名为 idm 的 feasibility path，但没有提供 numerical PTQ consequence signal。结合已经说明的 RoboTwin 2.0/LIBERO manipulation split 和 Fast-WAM-only staged validation budget，现在可以进行一个小规模 one-transition diagnostic；前提是 pre-run manifest 中固定 exact Optional IDM checkpoint identity。

几个相邻方向已经有工作覆盖。QuantWAMs 测量 joint video/action sensitivity，并修复 closed-loop protection schedule；QuantWM 研究 weight/activation PTQ sensitivity 和 long-horizon latent planning；Fast-WAM 没有提供用于 one-site W/A protection allocation 的 numerical PTQ consequence signal。更早的 task-consequence 工作——VAML、Model Advantage / Value-Aware Model Learning 和 Deep Task-Based Quantization——已经说明 downstream consequence 可以指导 targeting；SQIL 则通过 saliency-weighted QAT 和 action distillation 覆盖 critical-state protection。因此，更窄的 gap 是：当其他 target site 全部保持 FP16 时，一次 numerical W/A intervention 能否根据 paired full-action-chunk 和 next-observation discrepancy，提供可复现的 one-control-transition proxy。OTC-PTQ 不把这些更广泛的 downstream-consequence 或 critical-state-targeting 原则宣称为新贡献。

如果这个 gap 被填补，领域将得到一个有界 diagnostic，用来识别 local PTQ discrepancy 何时不再预测 contact states 上的一次 control transition consequence。它补充 QuantWAMs 的 closed-loop protection 分支和 QuantWM 的 latent-planning sensitivity 分支。它还可以检验 C_r-ranked schedule 是否能在相同 precision budget 下迁移到 held-out contact-sensitive failures 和 next-observation deviation；permutation 可以把 consequence association 与 quantizer 和 site-count controls 区分开来。这不会证明 task-loss identity、full-horizon/replan marginal、joint-low-bit optimality 或 bytes/latency objective。

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Freeze the manifest. Before any paired measurement, record the calibration registry, exact checkpoint and configuration identities, controller/RNG/history/cache restoration contract, and environment identity; halt when a required identity or restoration check is absent or mismatched.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: Both branches are interpretable as a paired consequence only when they start from the same recoverable state. This preserves the version boundary instead of treating an unverified checkpoint as interchangeable.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: For each numerical weight or activation site r, apply the chosen low-bit operator only at r and keep every other target site at FP16. Produce the single-site low-bit branch paired with the FP16 reference for the same calibration record.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This isolates the bounded single-site intervention and avoids treating joint coupling, joint-low-bit marginal effects, or joint optimality as new claims.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Run the matched FP16 and single-site branches to obtain complete action chunks, execute only the first action, and record the immediate next observation. Define d_a(j,r) as full-action-chunk MSE divided by max(sigma_a^2, epsilon_a^2), with sigma_a^2 the population variance over all scalar coordinates of FP16 chunks in D_cal. Define d_o(j,r) as mean per-pixel absolute next-observation difference divided by max(sigma_o, epsilon_o), with sigma_o the calibration mean per-pixel standard deviation. Use epsilon_a=epsilon_o=1e-3, lambda_a=lambda_o=1 by default, preregister the lambda_a/lambda_o sweep {0.5,1,2}, and aggregate C_r as the episode mean with bootstrap intervals over complete episodes. Define L_jr as the all-element mean squared hook-output difference and L_r as its episode mean; keep valid masks, observation preprocessing, and invalid-row policy explicit.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This defines a one-control-transition proxy for action-mediated consequence. C_r is not task loss, a full-horizon/replan marginal, or a jointly-low-bit marginal.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Rank sites by C_r and by local discrepancy separately. Define B_site as the nonnegative integer high-precision-site count recorded by the matched local-fidelity baseline, with B equivalent to B_site everywhere in this method; protect exactly the top-B_site sites and leave the others at b_lo. Keep numeric B_site as a manifest input, resolve ties by registry order, and record deployment bytes, activation workspace, scale/copy overhead, and measured latency separately from the site-count budget.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The comparison tests whether the proxy changes protection choices at a matched precision budget, rather than introducing a storage or runtime objective.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: On the exact manifest, run idm with sigma_shift_FW=1.0 and infer_action on the stated small held-out RoboTwin 2.0/LIBERO manipulation split, using the same b_lo and B. Compare contact-sensitive task failures and next-observation deviation for the two schedules. Then permute C_r across the site registry and use the stated oracle simulator-state branch as a positive control.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The contact-transition subset and permutation are mechanism tests: the candidate predicts ranking divergence and transfer for the real C_r association, with the advantage disappearing after permutation. The oracle branch checks calibration noise.

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 先冻结 manifest。 在任何 paired measurement 之前，记录 calibration registry、exact checkpoint 与 configuration identities、controller/RNG/history/cache restoration contract 和 environment identity；任何必需 identity 或 restoration check 缺失或不匹配时都 halt。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 只有两个 branch 都从同一个可恢复 state 开始，paired consequence 才能解释。这样可以保留 version boundary，不会把未经验证的 checkpoint 当作可互换对象。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 对每个 numerical weight 或 activation site r，只在 r 应用选定的 low-bit operator，其余 target site 全部保持 FP16。针对同一条 calibration record，生成与 FP16 reference 配对的 single-site low-bit branch。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这会隔离有界的 single-site intervention，也避免把 joint coupling、joint-low-bit marginal effects 或 joint optimality 当作新的 claim。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 让匹配的 FP16 branch 与 single-site branch 生成完整 action chunks，只执行第一个 action，并记录 immediate next observation。定义 d_a(j,r)：完整 action chunk 的 MSE 除以 max(sigma_a^2, epsilon_a^2)，其中 sigma_a^2 是 D_cal 中 FP16 chunks 所有 scalar coordinates 的 population variance。定义 d_o(j,r)：next observation 的 per-pixel 绝对差除以 max(sigma_o, epsilon_o)，其中 sigma_o 是 calibration 中 per-pixel standard deviations 的 mean。使用 epsilon_a=epsilon_o=1e-3，默认 lambda_a=lambda_o=1，预注册 lambda_a/lambda_o sweep {0.5,1,2}，并将 C_r 按 episode mean 聚合，在完整 episode 上计算 bootstrap intervals；定义 L_jr 为 paired hook outputs 所有 elements 的 MSE，L_r 为其 episode mean。valid masks、observation preprocessing 与 invalid-row policy 仍须明确记录。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这定义了一个表示 action-mediated consequence 的 one-control-transition proxy。C_r 不是 task loss、full-horizon/replan marginal，也不是 jointly-low-bit marginal。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 分别按照 C_r 和 local discrepancy 对 site 排名。将 B_site 定义为 matched local-fidelity baseline 在 preregistered manifest 中记录的 nonnegative integer high-precision-site count，并在本方法中固定 B 等价于 B_site；保护恰好 top-B_site sites，其余 site 保持 b_lo。B_site 的数值仍作为 manifest input，ties 按 registry order 处理；deployment bytes、activation workspace、scale/copy overhead 与 measured latency 必须和 site-count budget 分开记录。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这个比较检验 proxy 是否会在匹配的 precision budget 下改变 protection choice，而不是引入 storage 或 runtime objective。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在 exact manifest 上，使用 sigma_shift_FW=1.0 运行 idm，并在指定的小规模 held-out RoboTwin 2.0/LIBERO manipulation split 上运行 infer_action；两者使用相同的 b_lo 和 B。比较两个 schedule 的 contact-sensitive task failures 与 next-observation deviation。随后在 site registry 中 permutation C_r，并使用指定的 oracle simulator-state branch 作为 positive control。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: contact-transition subset 和 permutation 是 mechanism tests：candidate 预测真实 C_r association 会带来 ranking divergence 和 transfer，而 permutation 后这个 advantage 会消失。oracle branch 用来检查 calibration noise。

plain_method_modules_en.purpose_oneline: Provide replayable calibration states and exact version and configuration boundaries for paired measurement.
Create the bounded single-site W/A intervention and compute the one-control-transition C_r signal.
Use C_r and local discrepancy to form matched protection schedules while keeping budget meanings separate.
Test contact-transition divergence and bounded transfer with permutation and oracle controls.

plain_method_modules_zh.purpose_oneline: 提供可 replay 的 calibration state，并固定 paired measurement 所需的 exact version 与 configuration boundary。
建立有界的 single-site W/A intervention，并计算 one-control-transition C_r signal。
使用 C_r 和 local discrepancy 形成 matched protection schedule，同时分开表达不同 budget 的含义。
通过 permutation 和 oracle controls 检验 contact-transition divergence 与有界 transfer。
